paras: The Peravia least gecko (Sphaerodactylus ocoae), also known commonly as the Ocoa geckolet, is a species of lizard in the family Sphaerodactylidae. The species is endemic to the Dominican Republic.
The specific name, ocoae, refers to the Sierra de Ocoa mountain range.
Sphaerodactylus ocoae is found in Peravia Province, Dominican Republic.
The preferred habitat of Sphaerodactylus ocoae is forest.
